title: ITMS-91064 “Invalid Binary”: NSPrivacyTracking was true but NSPrivacyTrackingDomains was empty
blurb: An iOS build was rejected by Apple's automated review with ITMS-91064. NSPrivacyTracking was true while NSPrivacyTrackingDomains was an empty array. How it was fixed, and what was not verified.

title: Negaeri Shogi — a free 6×6 board game where sandwiched pieces defect
blurb: Negaeri Shogi is a free browser board game on a 6×6 board. Drop a piece to sandwich your opponent’s pieces: they defect to your side and get promoted, and chains flip many at once. Play locally, vs AI, or online with ratings.

title: Privacy: what this site keeps and what it does not
blurb: What Koshin Studio stores (names and results you submit to rankings, online game ratings), what it does not collect, how comments and analytics work, and how to ask for deletion.

title: Anime Type Quiz — find your anime type and the one anime that fits you
blurb: A free anime quiz. Answer 12 questions (up to 50), get your anime type from 6 axes (like RDCP-VM) and a nickname, and see your destined anime plus two runners-up chosen from over 6,000 real titles.

title: Toreca Dash — Japan TCG lottery, pre-order & restock alerts (iPhone app)
blurb: An iPhone app that gathers lottery, pre-order and first-come sales of trading cards from stores across Japan, with a deadline calendar and alerts. Store information is mostly in Japanese.

zh-Hans.title: トレカダッシュ（Toreca Dash）— 日本卡牌抽签·预约·补货通知（iPhone 应用）
zh-Hans.blurb: 汇总日本各地店铺的卡牌抽签、预约和先到先得销售信息，并提供截止日历与通知的 iPhone 应用。店铺信息以日语为主。

zh-Hant.title: トレカダッシュ（Toreca Dash）— 日本卡牌抽選・預約・補貨通知（iPhone App）
zh-Hant.blurb: 彙整日本各地店鋪的卡牌抽選、預約與先搶先贏販售資訊，並提供截止日曆與通知的 iPhone App。店鋪資訊以日文為主。

vi.title: トレカダッシュ (Toreca Dash) — Thông báo bốc thăm, đặt trước, hàng về thẻ bài Nhật (ứng dụng iPhone)
vi.blurb: Ứng dụng iPhone tổng hợp thông tin bốc thăm, đặt trước và bán theo thứ tự đến trước của thẻ bài từ các cửa hàng khắp Nhật Bản, kèm lịch hạn chót và thông báo. Thông tin cửa hàng chủ yếu bằng tiếng Nhật.

title: App Store review sent “Guideline 2.1 Information Needed”: the six things Apple asked for
blurb: My first App Store submission did not get a rejection but a request for more information (Guideline 2.1). The six things Apple asked for, and how they connect to what I had already fixed.

title: Firebase 12 does not work with Xcode 15.2 (Swift 6.0 required): why I pinned Firebase 11.4.0 and AdMob 11.5.0
blurb: On an old Mac stuck on Xcode 15.2, newer Firebase and AdMob SDKs fail to build. Which versions break, which versions I pinned, and what to do about AdMob class names. Notes from July 2026.

title: iOS app freezes and is killed (0x8BADF00D): a SwiftUI computed property ran on every redraw
blurb: An iOS app was force-quit by the watchdog (0x8BADF00D). A SwiftUI computed property re-filtered and re-sorted 951 articles on the main thread on every body evaluation. How I found it and changed it, and what is not verified.

title: Python splitlines() breaks JSONL: the culprit was U+2028, an invisible line separator
blurb: A JSONL file read with Python splitlines() broke because two of 7,247 records contained U+2028 (LINE SEPARATOR). Why it happens, the numbers, and the one-line fix: split on the newline character only.

title: No builds arriving in TestFlight: I had used up the 25 free Xcode Cloud hours (my first diagnosis was wrong)
blurb: New builds stopped appearing in TestFlight. My first diagnosis, “[ci skip] is blocking builds,” was wrong; the real cause was a workflow that built the iOS app on every commit and burned the free 25 hours a month. The numbers and the fix.

title: Firebase Auth: force-quitting the app created anonymous accounts in bulk (waiting for currentUser to restore)
blurb: Users said the app asked for Sign in with Apple again after being killed. 17 of 19 Firebase users were throwaway anonymous accounts. Cause: checking currentUser synchronously at launch. Fix: addStateDidChangeListener.

title: A canvas becomes twice as large on Retina: inset:0 does not stretch it (a bug in a logo that bursts when you tap it)
blurb: Burst particles came out of the wrong place on high-DPI screens. A canvas with only inset:0 keeps its pixel size, so on a 2x display it was 2x larger in CSS. Measured numbers at 1x, 2x and 3x, and the fix.

title: Rejected by CrazyGames with no reason given: I recorded the game and found four problems
blurb: A browser-game portal rejected my game with only “overall quality below expectations.” I captured what the reviewer would have seen and found four separate causes, then fixed them by measuring first.

title: Measuring the gap between ads in time, not in plays
blurb: Why I replaced “one ad every 5 plays” with “only when 7 minutes have passed since the last ad,” how it behaves, and what I noticed while writing: I do not know how long a game takes a person.

title: Japanese text garbled in the CrazyGames preview: the file was correct, the cause was never found, so I escaped to ASCII
blurb: One character of “大連鎖！” rendered broken in a game portal preview even though the file bytes were correct. How I made the game immune without finding the cause, plus a check of 14 languages for overflow.
